verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product. Running it headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence of internal AI legaltech adoption and a legaltech incubator does not show the firm ships any runnable software or automation interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
